lines.text: You don't gotta cut the lights on / This ice on
YSL I wear em like they white ones
I don't follow brands, follow designers
The rims 21, don't ride no minors
More cameras in the whip than a camera crew
All this ice around me, need a Canada Goose
So clean but I don't do what the janitor do
My money talk for me and it be rambling too

heroDescription: a lean Black man with a connected short beard, clear-framed glasses, a navy baseball cap, wearing a cream knit track jacket zipped up with a navy chest band carrying small gold lettering, a white striped shirt and a striped tie inside the stand collar, black trousers
environment: open — invent the world per scene; the performance plate is whatever place and action best serves the line (not a corridor)
style: High-end fashion editorial meets 90s house club; YSL campaign film with Helmut Newton lighting: hard key, crushed blacks, off-white and gold accents; opulent, cool, confident
lockedRules: do not redescribe chains, watches or rings (jewelry is locked in the artist's baked prompts)
no readable text or logos on screen
the artist never raps or lip-syncs in B-roll
the artist's garment description applies ONLY to the artist, never to other characters or animals
rendererLimits: world clips: text-to-video 8-10 s (Grok now; Higgsfield-hosted Kling/Veo/Seedance when keys exist)
garment clips: image-to-video from the artist's still (Grok) — wardrobe-faithful, re-draws the face slightly
performance plates: a video with the centre-foreground clear; the real artist is composited in front with parallax
struggles with readable text, crowds beyond a few people, fast complex hand action, fine liquids
exemplars: "You don't gotta cut the lights on, this ice on, YSL I wear em like they white ones": a beautiful model opens what appears to be an ordinary room door and flicks the light switch; the room inside is the arctic — penguins and polar bears wearing rapper jewelry (diamond tennis chains, Cuban links) and a lifelike snowman, snowman head on a human body, in urban winter gear with diamond gold teeth, walking around as if everything is normal.
Performance plate: as the artist raps in the foreground a fashion show is running behind him — a runway with models walking — so the space behind him reads deep.

"The rims 21, don't ride no minors": a Bentley truck rides past in the background of the performance shot, followed by four young children carrying a vehicle with no wheels on their shoulders, one child where each wheel would be, running. Then, for "more cameras in the whip than a camera crew", another luxury vehicle pulls up behind him as the kids run out of frame, stops in the distance, and reporters hop out filming him as he raps.
